SIDEKICK: ADOPTION != MERCHANT OUTCOME | G4-G6
|
|-- Adoption measures change; do not splice them into one series
|   |-- [S] Q1 2025: monthly users more than doubled since year-start.
|   |-- [S] Q3 2025: 750,000+ first-time shops; nearly 100M cumulative chats.
|   |-- [S] Q1 2026: weekly active shops '4x YoY'; Q&A says '+385%'.
|   |-- [I] 4x and +385% are not arithmetically identical.
|   |-- [S] Q2 2026: daily active merchants 3.6x YoY; Q&A says 3x.
|   |-- [S] Q2: nearly 34M chats; daily sessions 4.8x YoY.
|   `-- [S] Q3: daily active merchants 3.7x; daily sessions 4.2x YoY.
|
|-- Work performed
|   |-- [S] Custom apps: 12,000 Q1 -> 36,000+ Q2 2026.
|   |-- [S] Share of Flows created: nearly half Q1 -> two-thirds Q3.
|   |-- [S] Q2: extensions can act through third-party apps, e.g. Klaviyo.
|   `-- [I] App/Flow creation counts do not measure sustained business value.
|
|-- Merchant outcomes -[D:data]-> early-success milestones
|   |-- [S] Q2 2026: 8% lift in merchants reaching five orders in 15 days.
|   |-- [S] Q3 prepared remarks: 3% lift reaching NEXT five orders in 60 days.
|   |-- [S] Q3 Q&A instead says five orders in 60 days after using the guide.
|   |-- [I] Preserve this endpoint ambiguity; do not merge the two claims.
|   `-- [I] No control assignment, sample definition or uncertainty supplied.
|
`-- Canvas: expansion from advice into store creation
    |-- [S] Q3 2026 launch: describe a bespoke store to Sidekick.
    |-- [S] Stores launched 20% faster; roughly one month of observations.
    `-- [I] Baseline and comparison method not specified in supplied remarks.

[I] Cohort additions, active shops, sessions and chats measure different things.
[I] Merchant retention and incremental revenue are not quantified here.
